description.zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个。
description.en: The token that determines the start point of the next query. If this parameter is empty, no additional results exist.

description.zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：50。

默认值：10
description.en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 弹性伸缩资源所属地域的ID。
description.en: The ID of the region where the Auto Scaling resources reside.

description.zh: 弹性伸缩资源类型。取值：scalinggroup，表示标签绑定的对象是伸缩组。
description.en: The Auto Scaling resource type. Set the value to scalinggroup, which indicates that the tagged object is a scaling group.

title.zh: 查询弹性伸缩资源标签键对应的标签值
title.en: Query tag values of Auto Scaling resources by tag key

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ess list-tag-values --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type scalinggroup --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --page-size 10 --key ESS --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ess ListTagValues --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --PageSize 10 --ResourceType scalinggroup --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Key ESS
